en.title: P-A-V-A
en.decryption: Center of power was Pataliputra and Vidisha; known for Ashvamedha rites and Sanchi/Bharhut art.

hi.title: P-A-V-A
hi.decryption: Center of power was Pataliputra and Vidisha; known for Ashvamedha rites and Sanchi/Bharhut art.

fact.en: Confusing Shunga rule with a total anti-Buddhist purge; archaeological evidence at Sanchi/Bharhut shows Buddhist patronage continued.
fact.hi: Confusing Shunga rule with a total anti-Buddhist purge; archaeological evidence at Sanchi/Bharhut shows Buddhist patronage continued.

fact.en: Assuming the Shunga empire spanned the entire Mauryan territory; it was significantly smaller and fragmented.
fact.hi: Assuming the Shunga empire spanned the entire Mauryan territory; it was significantly smaller and fragmented.

fact.en: Misattributing the start of the 'Gandhara School' to Shungas (It is a later Kushan-era development).
fact.hi: Misattributing the start of the 'Gandhara School' to Shungas (It is a later Kushan-era development).
